data.one_liner: Inline day, week, range and month date pickers without dialogs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of customizable inline date picker widgets (DayPicker, WeekPicker, RangePicker, MonthPicker, YearPicker). Allows styling of dates, disabled dates, and special decorations, and returns DateTime values at selection.
use_when: You need an inline date picker that fits into your UI without opening a dialog
You want customizable styles for selected, current, and disabled dates
You need range or week selection support
avoid_when: You require a native platform date picker UI
You need a full-featured calendar with events and complex scheduling
strengths: No dialog, fits directly in layout
Supports day, week, range, month, and year selections
Null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Limited to inline UI, no built‑in dialog variant
Customization limited to provided style objects
No built‑in support for event calendars or recurring dates
